title: 第244章 左拥右抱齐人之福集齐完美之法材料第243章 不择手段的李长生真可怕
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 距离百花城举办拍卖会，还剩下最后三天时间。
如今繁荣的百花城已经被来自五湖四海的修士挤得水泄不通了。
如果是密集恐惧症拥有者，根本看不了一点。
就连周边的荒山都被驻扎上了各种各样的营地。
每时每刻都有神识在城市上空扫描。
百花城就像一个一点就炸的火药桶。
却是另外一副截然不同的景象。
敖琉璃躺在柔软的玉榻上。
但是不知道为什么就逐渐沦陷了。
现在居然愿意给眼前的男人剥葡萄了。
或者说对眼前的男人爱到了骨子里。
而琉璃将亲手剥好的葡萄，放在李长生嘴边。
李长生十分惬意地张开嘴，连着敖琉璃那白嫩的指尖一起，轻轻地咬了一下。
也不知道是在说菩提甜，还是在说别的什么甜。
敖琉璃感到手指上传来的触感。
李长生听到敖琉璃的尖叫，心底竟然有些兴奋。
另一边，敖琉璃跪坐在地毯上，双手放在李长生的腿上，熟练替李长生捏腿。
其手法自然是无可挑剔的。
一边用水汪汪的大眼睛，时不时偷瞄着李长生。
李长生也是体验到当家主人的感觉了。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye.
Almost three months have passed.
There are only three days left before the auction is held in Baihua City.
Nowadays, the prosperous Baihua City has been overcrowded by monks from all over the world.
Look up.
Densely decorated.
Just like locusts.
If you have trypophobia, you won't be able to see it at all.
The streets were crowded.
The inn was full.
The streets are congested.
Even the surrounding barren mountains are stationed in various camps.
Divine consciousness is scanning the sky over the city at all times.
Baihua City is like a powder keg that is about to explode.
And in the center of this powder keg.
In the private room of Baihua Building.
But it is a completely different scene.
Ao Liuli lay on the soft jade couch.
She was a very proud person.
Ben wouldn't do such a thing.
But I don’t know why it gradually fell into decline.
Now he is actually willing to peel grapes for the man in front of him.
In other words, she loves the man in front of her to the core.
And Liuli put the grapes peeled by her own hands to Li Changsheng's mouth.
"Husband, here you go."
Li Changsheng opened his mouth very contentedly, and gently bit Ao Liuli's white fingertips.
"Mmm, that's so sweet."
I don’t know if I am talking about the sweetness of Bodhi or some other sweetness.
Ah~
Ao Liuli felt the touch on her fingers.
The face is slightly red.
I couldn't help but let out a scream.
Haha...
Li Changsheng felt a little excited when he heard Ao Liuli's scream.
The more you call me, the more excited I become.
? ? ?
What a pervert.
On the other side, Ao Liuli knelt on the carpet, put her hands on Li Changsheng's legs, and pinched Li Changsheng's legs skillfully.
As a mythical weapon spirit.
His approach is naturally impeccable.
While pinching the legs upward.
While using his big watery eyes, he glanced at Li Changsheng from time to time.
Her face was red.
Seems quite cute.
Li Changsheng also experienced the feeling of being the master of the family.
title_en: Chapter 244: The blessing of embracing everyone and gathering the perfect magic materials Chapter 243: The unscrupulous Li Changsheng is really scary
